basic_details.job_title: ECHS Bareilly Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Medical Officer, Gynecologist Posts

qualification.details: Medical Officer: MBBS | Gynecologist: MD/MS in Specialty concerned

how_to_apply: Download or obtain the application form from the official website echs.gov.in.
Fill out the application form with required details.
Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates, degrees, physical fitness certificates and all relevant documents.
Submit the application to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Bareilly either by post or in person.
Ensure the application reaches the designated authority on or before 21 October 2026 by 01 PM.
Attend the interview on 24 October 2026 at Stn Cell Bareilly carrying original certificates, degree, experience certificate, physical fitness certificate, and two PP size photographs.

rows.details: One year (renewal for additional period of one year/till attaining maximum age)

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: There are a total of 03 vacancies distributed across the notified medical posts at ECHS Polyclinic Bareilly.

rows.experience: Minimum 03 years in the specialty after PG

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The consolidated monthly salary is Rs. 95,000/- for the Medical Officer and Rs. 1,30,000/- for Gynecologist. Appointments are made on a contractual basis for a period of one year, with provisions for renewal for an additional period of one year or until attaining the maximum age subject to performance and other conditions. Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen. Selected candidates will carry out 10 days of On the Job Training (OJT) and obtain a certificate from the Officer-in-Charge polyclinic before signing the contract. This OJT duration will remain unpaid and serves as a mandatory requirement before assuming charge as a contractual employee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ECHS Bareilly Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the application form from the official website echs.gov.in. Fill out the application form with required details. Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates, degrees, physical fitness certificates and all relevant documents. Submit the application to OIC, Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Bareilly either by post or in person. Ensure the application reaches the designated authority on or before 21 October 2026 by 01 PM. Attend the interview on 24 October 2026 at Stn Cell Bareilly carrying original certificates, degree, experience certificate, physical fitness certificate, and two PP size photographs.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of certificate and degree Physical fitness certificate (issued by CMO/SEMO as applicable) Experience certificate All relevant supporting documents Two PP size photographs (required at the time of interview) Original certificates, degree, and experience certificates for verification during interview

rows.details: Download official notification and application form details

faq.question: Q1. Is the appointment permanent or on contract, and for how long?
faq.answer: The appointment is on a contractual basis for a period of one year, with a provision for renewal for an additional period of one year or until attaining the maximum age subject to performance.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date of receipt of application along with self-attested photocopies of certificates, degrees, physical fitness certificates and documents is 21 October 2026 up to 01 PM.

faq.question: Q3. When and where is the interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The interview is scheduled to be held between 1000 hrs to 1500 hrs on 24 October 2026 at Stn Cell Bareilly. Candidates must reach Stn HQs (ECHS Cell) Bareilly by 0900 hrs on the interview date.

faq.question: Q4. Who will be given preference during selection?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to Ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q5. Will candidates receive any stipend or pay during the 10-day On the Job Training (OJT)?
faq.answer: No, the 10 days of On the Job Training (OJT) will remain unpaid as it is a mandatory requirement before assuming charge.
